_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing short lines for asking the way

items.en: Where can I find a bank?

segments.text: Lost in a new city? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.
Where can I find a bank?

native.caption: Yabancı bir şehirde yolu nasıl soracağını bilmiyor musun? Bu 4 cümleyi kaydet: “Where can I find a bank?” ve “Thank you very much.” Carlos hocayı dinle, sessizlikte sen tekrar et. Lexkite uygulamasında daha fazla çalış.

en.hook: How do you ask for directions?
en.caption: Not sure how to ask the way in a new city? Save these 4 lines: “Where can I find a bank?” and “Thank you very much.” Listen to Carlos, then repeat in the pause. Study more in the Lexkite app.
